note: Attacker-controlled bytes are copied into an in-memory file and then parsed as a BAM/SAM/VCF stream.
For sequence_data inputs, each decoded BAM record is handed to sam_write1 for re-serialization.

The BAM qname bytes are read verbatim from the file into the record buffer; the parser only appends padding NULs, so the stored qname may still lack an in-band terminator at the logical name boundary.

When writing SAM text, the code treats the qname as a C string source and copies a length derived from qname metadata; later diagnostics in the same path also print bam_get_qname(b) with %s, which can read past the intended qname if the record's qname bytes are not NUL-terminated as expected.
